notes: Replaced the 3 old classical Jothidam texts with a much larger modern KP/Jyotisha reference library (KP Readers 1-6, Astrology for Beginners, KP Ezine archives, Navaratnamala, Sub Lord SPK, and more) — Astro readings, marriage matching, and Jadhagam uploads now draw on these instead. This whole reference library moved server-side (needs the latest server.js + lib/ + data/ deployed too) — the app itself no longer bundles or fetches any book text, it just asks for a prediction. Added a Doctor-mode terminology quiz (4 short OCD/clinical questions, one-time) before that mode unlocks, since it now shares direct citations from the app's OCD/mental-health reference library for a verified doctor's clinical questions. Mind Winner mode also gets warm, supportive grounding from that same library when a message shows OCD-like signs — never a diagnosis, never medical advice.
